recipes.name: Spaghetti puttanesca
recipes.method_note: The sauce should look thick, not watery. Give it the full time.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan of water on a high heat.
steps.note: It takes a while to boil, so it goes on first.

steps.instruction: Put a wide frying pan on a low heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} finely.
Add the garlic to the oil. Cook 2 minutes, until it smells sweet.
steps.note: Low heat. Browned garlic turns bitter.

steps.instruction: Add {{ing:anchovy-fillet}}. Stir 2 minutes, until they fall apart.
steps.note: They dissolve into the oil. This is meant to happen.

steps.instruction: Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}.
Add {{ing:olives-pitted}} and {{ing:capers}}.
Turn the heat to medium. Cook 12 minutes, until it looks thick rather than watery.
Add {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} to the boiling water. Cook for the time on the packet.
Drain the spaghetti. Keep a mugful of the water.
Tip the spaghetti into the sauce. Stir.
steps.note: If it looks dry, add the pasta water a splash at a time.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan of water on a high heat.
Put a frying pan on a low heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} finely. Add to the oil.
Cook 2 minutes, until it smells sweet.
steps.note: Do not let it brown.

steps.instruction: Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, {{ing:salt}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
steps.note: The sugar takes the sharp edge off tinned tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Cook 15 minutes on a medium heat, until thick.
Add {{ing:penne-dry}} to the boiling water. Cook for the time on the packet.
Drain the pasta.
Tear {{ing:fresh-basil}} into the sauce. Stir once.
Tip the pasta into the sauce. Stir to coat.

recipes.name: Mushroom risotto
recipes.method_note: Risotto needs stirring. Put a podcast on.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:stock-vegetable}} in a pan. Keep it on a low heat.
steps.note: Cold stock stops the rice cooking each time you add it.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} finely.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}.
Put a wide pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Add the onion. Cook 6 minutes, until soft and see-through.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} and add it. Cook 1 minute.
Add the mushrooms. Cook 5 minutes, until they release their liquid.
Add {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}}. Stir 1 minute, until the grains look glassy at the edges.
Add a ladle of hot stock. Stir until it has almost gone.
Keep adding stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
steps.note: The rice should be soft with a slight bite. You may not need all the stock.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat. Stir in {{ing:butter-block}}.
Grate {{ing:parmesan}} in. Stir once and rest 2 minutes.
Put {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} between two sheets of baking paper.
Bash each one flat with a rolling pin, to about 1 cm thick.
steps.note: Even thickness is what stops the thin end drying out.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:flour-plain}} on a plate. Add {{ing:salt}}.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} in a shallow bowl.
Put {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} on a third plate.
Coat each piece in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
steps.note: Press the crumbs on firmly.

steps.instruction: Put a large frying pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Fry two pieces for 4 minutes, until deep golden underneath.
Turn them over. Fry 4 minutes more.
steps.note: The chicken is done when it is white all the way through.

steps.instruction: Lift onto kitchen paper. Fry the other two.
Cut {{ing:lemon}} into wedges and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Minestrone
recipes.method_note: Thick soup, not broth. Add water at the end if you want it looser.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}} small.
steps.note: Small pieces cook evenly and eat better in a spoon.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Add the chopped vegetables. Cook 10 minutes, until softened.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} and add it. Cook 1 minute.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Bring to a simmer. Small bubbles, not a rolling boil.
Cook 15 minutes.
Drain {{ing:cannellini-beans-tinned}} and add them.
Add {{ing:penne-dry}}. Cook 10 minutes more.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
recipes.method_note: No cream. The egg and cheese make the sauce, off the heat.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan of water on a high heat.
Chop {{ing:bacon-rasher-back}} into strips.
Beat {{ing:egg-yolk}} in a bowl. Grate in {{ing:parmesan}}.
Add {{ing:black-pepper-ground}} and mix to a paste.
Fry the bacon on a medium heat 6 minutes, until crisp.
Add {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} to the boiling water. Cook per the packet.
Drain the pasta. Keep a mugful of the water.
Take the bacon pan OFF the heat.
steps.note: This is the step that decides whether it works.

steps.instruction: Tip the pasta in. Stir for 20 seconds to cool it.
Pour in the egg mixture. Stir hard until glossy.
Loosen with pasta water a splash at a time.

recipes.name: Lasagne
recipes.method_note: A long one. The ragu is most of the work and can be made ahead.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}} small.
Put a large pan on a medium heat with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Cook the vegetables 10 minutes, until soft.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} and add it. Cook 1 minute.
Add {{ing:beef-mince-20-fat}}. Break it up. Cook 10 minutes.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}. Simmer 40 minutes.
steps.note: Longer is better if you have it.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a clean pan.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Cook 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:milk-whole}} a splash at a time, whisking, until smooth.
Cook 6 minutes, until it coats a spoon.
Heat the oven to 190C.
Layer ragu, pasta sheets and white sauce twice in a dish.
Grate {{ing:parmesan}} over the top.
Bake 40 minutes, until browned and bubbling.
Put a large pan of water on a high heat.
Add {{ing:penne-dry}}. Cook for the time on the packet.
Halve {{ing:cherry-tomato}}.
Toast {{ing:pumpkin-seeds}} in a dry pan 3 minutes.
steps.note: Shake the pan so they do not catch.

steps.instruction: Drain the pasta. Keep a mugful of the water.
Stir {{ing:pesto}} through the pasta off the heat.
Loosen with pasta water if it looks dry.
Add the tomatoes and seeds. Grate {{ing:parmesan}} over.

recipes.name: Margherita pizza
recipes.method_note: The dough needs an hour to rise. Start early.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:flour-strong-white-bread}} and {{ing:salt}} in a bowl.
Add {{ing:water}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}. Mix to a rough dough.
Knead 8 minutes, until smooth and springy.
Cover and leave 60 minutes, until doubled.
Heat the oven as high as it goes.
Stretch the dough onto a floured tray.
Spread {{ing:passata}} to the edges.
Tear {{ing:mozzarella}} over.
Bake 10 minutes, until the edges are blistered.
Tear {{ing:fresh-basil}} over after it comes out.
steps.note: Basil burns in the oven.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} small.
Put a pan on a medium heat with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Cook the vegetables 10 minutes, until soft.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} and add it with {{ing:dried-oregano}}.
Add {{ing:lentils-red-dry}}, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer 25 minutes, until the lentils collapse.
Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} for the time on the packet.
Drain and stir through the ragu.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Slice {{ing:aubergine}} into rounds about 1 cm thick.
Brush with {{ing:olive-oil}} and lay on a tray.
Roast 25 minutes, until soft and golden.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} and cook in a pan 1 minute.
Add {{ing:passata}}. Simmer 15 minutes, until thick.
Tear {{ing:fresh-basil}} into the sauce.
Layer aubergine, sauce and torn {{ing:mozzarella}} in a dish.
Grate {{ing:parmesan}} over the top.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling.

recipes.name: Lemon and pea risotto
recipes.method_note: Risotto needs stirring. Put something on to listen to.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:stock-vegetable}} in a pan and keep it warm.
steps.note: Cold stock stalls the rice each time.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} finely.
Put a wide pan on a medium heat with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Cook the onion 6 minutes, until see-through.
Add {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}}. Stir 1 minute, until glassy at the edges.
Add a ladle of stock. Stir until it has almost gone.
Keep adding stock a ladle at a time for 16 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:peas-frozen}}. Cook 3 minutes more.
Take off the heat. Add {{ing:butter-block}} and grate in {{ing:parmesan}}.
Zest and squeeze {{ing:lemon}} in. Rest 2 minutes.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}} small.
steps.note: Small pieces eat better in a spoon.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Cook the vegetables 10 minutes.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Add {{ing:penne-dry}}. Cook 10 minutes.
Drain {{ing:cannellini-beans-tinned}} and add them.
Shred {{ing:kale}} and stir it in. Cook 3 minutes.
Peel and boil {{ing:potato-large}} 20 minutes. Drain and mash.
Let the mash cool 10 minutes.
steps.note: Hot mash makes gluey gnocchi.

steps.instruction: Mix in {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:egg-medium}} to a soft dough.
Roll into ropes and cut into thumb-sized pieces.
Boil them 2 minutes, until they float. Lift out.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Cook in {{ing:olive-oil}} 1 minute.
Add {{ing:passata}}. Simmer 12 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Mix the gnocchi into the sauce in a dish.
Tear {{ing:mozzarella}} over. Bake 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Boil {{ing:penne-dry}} for two minutes less than the packet says.
steps.note: It finishes cooking in the oven.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a pan on a medium heat.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Cook 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:milk-whole}} a splash at a time, whisking.
Cook 5 minutes, until thick. Grate in half the {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Drain {{ing:tuna-tinned-in-spring-water}} and {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}}.
Mix everything in an oven dish.
Grate the rest of the cheese over. Bake 25 minutes.
Chop {{ing:tomato-medium}} small and put in a bowl.
Add {{ing:salt}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}. Leave 10 minutes.
steps.note: The salt draws the juice out.

steps.instruction: Toast {{ing:bread-slice-medium}} until crisp.
Cut {{ing:garlic-clove}} in half. Rub it over the hot toast.
Spoon the tomatoes on.
Tear {{ing:fresh-basil}} over.
Put a large pan of water on a high heat.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}.
Put a wide pan on a high heat with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry the mushrooms 8 minutes, until browned at the edges.
steps.note: Do not crowd the pan or they steam.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} and add it. Cook 1 minute.
Add {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} to the water. Cook per the packet.
Pour {{ing:double-cream}} into the mushrooms. Simmer 3 minutes.
Drain the pasta and stir it through.
Grate {{ing:parmesan}} in. Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}} over.
